profile.name: Dista Reza
profile.summary:
I am **Technical Leader**, **Senior System Analyst** and **Senior Software Engineer** and Developer for developing, maintaining, support and monitoring many enterprise system applications for various companies since year 2002 until now as detailed on my working experience below.

I have been involved in full stack system development project using Java Enterprise Platform, Shell scripting and Oracle DB, as well as in collaborating with other system like SAP, Dot Net application other external system with having full knowledge of DevOps with experiences in adoption Agile Methodology for multiple types of Business Domain (Telecommunication, Manufacture, Financial, Scheduling System and more) in various type of Industry (Telecoms, Automotive Manufacture, Airline Services, Finance Banking and more) and with various technology area (Middleware, Enterprise, Backend Processes, Web application and Desktop application). My Bachelors Degree of Informatics Engineering came from STTTelkom (now known as Telkom University), Bandung, West Java, Indonesia, in July 2002.

I start my career as *Programmer* in Software Consultant Company in Jakarta Indonesia, and after a decade years later of dedication, I decided to move to Malaysia to explore more interesting opportunity. I sharpen my technical skill through the involvement and working experiences in many projects with multi type of business domain in multinational company and in a variety type of Industry and Technology.

specialties: Enterprise Development with Java Enterprise Technology using variant framework such as Spring, Apache Wicket, Struts, Java Servlet, EJB & JSP using multiple IDE like Eclipse, Rational Application Developer, IntelliJ on many Web Server Container Like Apache Tomcat, Jboss, IBM Web sphere.
Familiar Development using GitHub repository along with Maven and Ant build tool and Continues Deployment and Development tool such as Jenkins
Hibernate, Spring JPA and Simple JDBC Development
Virtual Machine Development Using VirtualBox, WLS2 and docker container
Experience with Linux Development Environment like Bash Shell, Korn Shell, Monit and Corn Scripting
Experience working with Cache Service like Oracle Coherence, and Apache Solr

Experience working with Oracle DB and mySQL, experience in Query manipulation or modifying Data model, Procedure, Packages, Function and Database Administration like indexing and optimizing query with Oracle Database.
Web Programming with Dynamic HTML using JavaScript (jQuery)

Senior Software Engineer at DXC Technology, Malaysia
Senior Java Developer at Hewlett Packard, Malaysia
Technical Leader at PT. Visi Solusi Teknologi, Indonesia
IT Staff at Mandala Airlines Indonesia
